name: Surf City
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Surf City?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. On Long Beach Island, registered LSVs may use streets posted 25 mph or less. Long Beach Boulevard is mostly posted 30 to 40 mph, so cross it rather than drive it.

lsv.notes: Cross Long Beach Blvd at intersections

rules.rule: Plain golf carts aren't street-legal; only titled, registered and insured LSVs that meet 49 CFR 571.500
LSVs only on roads posted 25 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections
Surf City police register and enforce LSV rules on the island

banned_roads.name: Long Beach Boulevard (where posted over 25 mph)

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Surf City?
faq.a: Roads posted 25 mph or less. Cross Long Beach Blvd at intersections. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Long Beach Boulevard in Surf City?
faq.a: Only where it's posted 25 mph or less. Most of the boulevard is posted 30 to 40 mph, so LSVs cross it at intersections.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Surf City?
faq.a: No. New Jersey only lets titled, registered and insured LSVs on public roads.
